_why: Campaign 4 of #4966: Buddhism as it reached English readers, 1830–1930 — the Orientalist translations (Beal, Rhys Davids, Oldenberg, Max Müller's Sacred Books volumes, Warren, Csoma), the popularisers (Arnold's Light of Asia, Carus's Gospel of Buddha — Carus ONLY where the title names Buddhism; The Open Court and his ethics lectures are OUT), the first Western Buddhists (Ananda Metteyya, Dharmapala), and Japanese Buddhism in English (Suzuki, Anesaki, Kanai). Archaeological surveys are IN only where the title names a Buddhist monument.
